"'''Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes'''" was a report written by historian [[Gabrel Treon]].

==Contents==
The article detailed the history of the prestigious [[House Praji/Legends|Praji]] family tree and was published in the publication ''[[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]]''.
